description: Discover this luxury apartment on the 9th floor of the prestigious 16th arrondissement, offering spectacular views of the Eiffel Tower from every room. Spacious and elegant, it has a living room with sofa bed, a bedroom with queen size bed, another with two double beds, and a royal bathroom with separate toilet. Enjoy a private balcony, a modern elevator, and fiber optics for an unforgettable Parisian stay.The spaceThe Jasmine Suite is an elegant 65 m² apartment, located on the 9th floor of a building with an elevator, in the heart of the prestigious 16th arrondissement of Paris. Perfectly designed to accommodate up to 6 people, it offers a comfortable and refined living environment for an unforgettable stay in Paris.Here is the layout of this harmonious space:Bright living room with cozy sofa bed, and a dining area ideal for your convivial moments.Fully equipped open kitchen, where you can prepare your meals with high-end equipment: stove, microwave, kettle, coffee on site, oven, dishwasher and a coffee machine.Cozy master bedroom with a queen size bed, perfect for a well-deserved night's rest.Secondary bedroom with two small double beds Modern and luxurious bathroom with shower gel, shampoo, hairdryer and separate toilet for added convenience.A large bright balcony offering a splendid view of the Parisian Eiffel Tower, perfect for breakfast.The apartment has many amenities for your comfort: free Wi-Fi, sheets, blankets and a set of towels per person. Here you will find everything you need for a pleasant and convenient stay.Guest accessFeel at home here! The accommodation is entirely yours for the duration of your stay, and all the equipment is at your disposal so that you don't miss anything.Other things to noteStaying at 26 rue de l'Yvette means treating yourself to
